description: This PHP class defines a data model for question scores within a questionnaire system. It includes properties for score-related data, methods for retrieving, aggregating, and saving score data, and interacts with a database table 'question_score'.

classes.name: Score
classes.description: A model class representing a question score record, with methods to validate, retrieve, and persist data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the score object. Currently always returns true.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of score records with optional filtering, pagination, and counting.

methods.name: getByAnswer
methods.description: Retrieves a score record for a specific answer.

methods.name: getScoreByAnswers
methods.description: Calculates the sum of scores for a list of answers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current score object to the database, performing validation and handling exceptions.
